objective:
Answer this question about chain 1 over blocks 26112859 to 26113157 (closing hash <hex64>), exactly as .imd/reads/oracle.json pins it:

Does WETH9 (0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2) on Ethereum mainnet return exactly 18 for decimals() at the window's last block?

Answer type: bool. Evidence: chain.

Public endpoints for chain 1, verified; use one:
- https://rpc.flashbots.net/fast
- https://rpc.mevblocker.io/fast
- https://one.valve.city/rpc/vk_demo/evm/1
- https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
- https://rpc.mevblocker.io
- https://rpc.flashbots.net

Three steps: (1) compute it with node .imd/reads/skills/oracle-assess/scripts/scan.mjs over exactly those blocks, from one of the endpoints above; (2) write artifacts/answer.json with the recipe that reproduces it; (3) run node .imd/reads/skills/oracle-assess/scripts/check-answer.mjs and fix what it prints. Scan again only when the total is zero or the checker objects. Nothing else needs reading first: the brief above is in .imd/reads/oracle.json with the recipe parameters, and .imd/reads/skills/oracle-assess/REFERENCE.md explains a field if the checker asks for one.
